entries.notes: EXP-0037 write-watched all 96 bytes of the three arrays across the scheduled opening route: 162 value-changing writes, identical across a GUI run and headless runs (frame+addr+old+new+PC), snapshots replay-consistent, final WRAM byte-identical to milestone 05. 20 flags touched: 11 latched story flags (all via the script handlers), 4 transient, 5 fast-toggling working bits ($1EB6 low nibble + bits 4/6 are engine working state living inside the flag address space). Boot clears the whole span at frame 21. Static decode extends the same handler family to five more bases ($1EE0/$1F00/$1F20/$1F40/$1DC9) — runtime-unobserved; and $1EC0 has set/clear handlers but no test routine in the decoded family. entries.name: Event-flag bit arrays and their set/clear routines
entries.description: Three parallel bit arrays at WRAM:+$1E80, +$1EA0 and +$1EC0, each $20 bytes apart (256 flags each). A shared decoder at ROMCPU:$BAED converts a flag number to array indices: REP #$20 / TAX / LSR x3 / TAY (byte index = flag/8) / TDC / SEP #$20 / TXA / AND #$07 / TAX (bit index = flag&7). Set routines read-modify-write with ORA $C0BAFC,X (masks 01 02 04 08 10 20 40 80); clear routines use AND $C0BB04,X (masks FE FD FB F7 EF DF BF 7F, exact complements). Live-observed writer: STA $1EA0,Y at ROMCPU:$C0B5B3 (the probe reports the following PC, $C0B5B6). Access sites: LDA $1EA0,Y x5 / STA $1EA0,Y x4, with symmetric counts for the $1E80 and $1EC0 arrays. Located by CONTRA-0002 while refuting a map-id reading of WRAM:+$1EA5, which is byte 5 of the $1EA0 array (flags $28-$2F); at milestone 05 its bits 0, 2 and 3 are set, i.e. flags $28, $2A, $2B.
